pokedexEntries.bk: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

pokedexEntries.wh: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

pokedexEntries.sw: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.

pokedexEntries.sh: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
